name: Optizen
summary: Shopify app that puts video upsells and bundles on product, cart and post-purchase pages, using your own clips or AI-generated ones.
best_for: shopify stores that already own product video and want it working as an upsell at the product page, cart and post-purchase moments, or that want to test a handful of AI-generated clips cheaply before committing
skip_if: you want generated video across a large catalogue — the per-credit pricing, not the $9.99, is then the real bill — or you need an app with a merchant track record you can check before you install
honest_knock: AI video is the reason to install this, and it is the one thing the subscription does not cover. Starter's $9.99 buys two generated clips a month and Pro's $29.99 buys five; after that you pay $2 or $1.50 per clip. A store with fifty products that wants a video on each is buying credits, not a plan, and should price it that way before signing up. The free tier is a demo rather than a usable floor — one campaign, five conversions, no AI at all. And there is almost no merchant track record to read: the app launched on 30 October 2025 and, read 5 October 2026, carries exactly one App Store review, a five-star note from 11 November 2025 by a store that had used it for two days, so nearly a year in, you would in effect be the test.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month, plus $2 per extra AI video credit beyond the 2 included
pricing.notes: (prices read 2026-08-31 on apps.shopify.com/optizen-video-upsell; re-read 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-05, every amount unchanged) Three tiers, billed in USD. Free gives one active video upsell campaign, up to 5 conversions and bundles, YouTube or Vimeo videos only and all available placements, with a 7-day free trial. Starter is $9.99 a month and removes the campaign and conversion limits, adds AI-generated video and includes 2 AI video credits a month; extra credits are $2 each, sold in bundles of $2, $10, $20 and $40. Pro is $29.99 a month for everything in Starter plus 5 AI video credits a month, all placements and priority support, with extra credits at $1.50 (bundles of $1.50, $7.50, $15 and $30). The subscription is flat. The AI video generation on top of it is not.

cost_traps.evidence: Starter is $9.99 a month and removes the campaign and conversion limits, adds AI-generated video and includes 2 AI video credits a month; extra credits are $2 each, sold in bundles of $2, $10, $20 and $40.

compare_with.name: AfterSell
compare_with.why: AfterSell is the broader, longer-established post-purchase upsell app on Shopify and the safer default if what you want is upsell coverage as such. Optizen is narrower on purpose: the offer is video, either yours or AI-generated, placed at product, cart and post-purchase moments. Choose Optizen if video is the thing you believe will move the offer — and price the AI credits before you do. Choose AfterSell if you want a track record and a wider feature set behind the upsell itself.
